metadata.name: Opening Presets
metadata.description: Configure one persistent starting-loadout screen when a new run begins. Collectibles are grouped by ItemConfig quality from 4 down to 0, prioritized by power within each quality, and displayed in a bordered, centered 60%-width panel with three columns and overflow-safe groups. One universal loadout applies to all characters, supports per-item counts, and can remove copies granted by the mod. Dynamic keyboard/controller help and MCM-configurable panel shortcuts. Uses EID Chinese names and font.
